artifact: A cache keeps a result so you can reuse it later. The detail to watch is what happens when the underlying data changes. If the cached copy has not been removed or refreshed, it may be stale. An invalidation rule decides when to remove or refresh that copy. Here, we are following one cache, so the explanation does not cover coordination among multiple services.
